stories.title: Bond yields, midterms, and earnings set to test stocks' fourth-quarter strength
stories.summary: US stocks typically gain in the fourth quarter. This year, rising bond yields, the midterm elections, and a new round of corporate earnings threaten that seasonal pattern, Investing.com reports.
stories.whyItMatters: A weak fourth quarter would break a seasonal pattern many investors count on, so the test matters for portfolio positioning.
whatToWatch: Bond yield moves in coming weeks
Q3 earnings reports from major companies
questions: How high do yields need to climb to derail stocks?
Will earnings season offset the political uncertainty?

sources.title: Spiking bond yields, midterms, earnings to test US stocks’ typical fourth-quarter strength
